question: The first modern Olympic Games was held in the year ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**1896.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• ** The International Olympic Committee (IOC) was founded in 1894, and it was decided that the first modern Olympic Games would be held two years later in Athens, Greece.**
 
• The first modern Olympic Games were held from **April 6 to April 15, 1896, and featured 14 nations and 241 athletes competing in 43 events.**
 
• The Games were a huge success and helped to revive the ancient tradition of** Olympic competition, which had been dormant for more than 1,500 years.**
 
• The modern Olympic Games have been held every four years since 1896, with the exception of 1916, 1940, and 1944 due to World War I and II.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• The Olympic flag has a white background, with five interlaced rings in the centre: blue, yellow, black, green, and red.

 
 
• Each colour corresponds to a particular continent: blue for Europe, yellow for Asia, black for Africa, green for Australia and Oceania, and red for the Americas.
 
 
 
• The Olympic motto “Citius, Altius, Fortius” (“Faster, Higher, Stronger”) was coined by Father Henri Didon.
 
• Only three modern Olympic Games have been cancelled.
 
 
• The games were cancelled due to World War I (1914) and World War II (1940, 1944).
 
 
 
• The youngest Olympian is Greek gymnast Dimitrios Loundras, who competed in the 1896 Athens Olympics at the age of 10.
